items.description: Leak detection call-out
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.7(e) covers the investigation necessary to locate the source of damage; reference case 20 shows t >= 481 for a similar call-out.

items.description: Electro-acoustic pinpointing of the leak beneath the kitchen sink
items.rationale: Covered as part of necessary leak detection under 7.1.7(e); reference case 20 shows t >= 707 for a combined detection/technician/vehicle line, so for just the pinpointing, t is likely lower.

items.description: Moisture measurement of the kitchen floor and wall base
items.rationale: Covered under 7.1.7(e) as measurement necessary to establish extent of moisture; reference case 20 includes this in the main detection line, but as a separate line, t is likely moderate.

items.description: Service technician hours (14 hrs)
items.rationale: Labour for covered detection and measurement is indemnified under 7.1.7(g); reference case 18 shows t between 966 and 1100 for a day and a half with a helper, so for 14 hours solo, t is likely around 900.

items.description: Vehicle costs (leak detection)
items.rationale: First vehicle/call-out charge per contractor is covered (7.1.7(f)); reference case 18 shows t >= 68 for vehicle costs.

items.description: Freeing the affected pipe run beneath the kitchen sink
items.rationale: Necessary preparatory work for repair (7.1.7(a)); reference case 18 includes similar work in the main repair line.

items.description: Removal and disposal of damaged insulation (2 pcs)
items.rationale: Removal/disposal of affected material is covered (7.1.7(a)); reference case 18 shows t >= 57 for construction waste disposal.

items.description: Repair of the confirmed leak and replacement copper pipe section with standard insulation
items.rationale: Direct repair of insured damage (2.4.2, 7.1.1(b)); reference case 18 shows t >= 221 for similar copper pipe repair.

items.description: Room drying line item for the roof space (Dachstuhl)
items.rationale: No evidence of roof space damage in the loss description or photo; 7.1.5 excludes work beyond affected parts.

items.description: Condensation dryer (kitchen)
items.rationale: Drying equipment for affected kitchen area is covered (7.1.7(b)); reference case 20 shows t below 200 for large-area drying, so for a single kitchen, t is likely lower.

items.description: Room drying of the kitchen floor and wall base
items.rationale: Drying of affected areas is covered (7.1.7(b)); reference case 20 shows t below 200 for large-area drying, so for a single kitchen, t is likely lower.

items.description: Transition pieces and standard insulation for the repaired section
items.rationale: Consumables and standard insulation for repair are covered (7.1.7(c)); reference case 18 shows t >= 107 for pipe re-insulation.

items.description: Final site cleaning of the covered work area
items.rationale: Cleaning of the work area after repair is covered (7.1.7(h)); reference case 18 shows t below 60 for tile cleaning, so for basic site cleaning, t is likely similar or lower.

items.description: Vehicle costs (drying technology)
items.rationale: First vehicle/call-out charge per contractor is covered (7.1.7(f)); reference case 18 shows t >= 68 for vehicle costs.

items.description: Removal of the water-damaged wooden kitchen table
items.rationale: Removal of destroyed furnishing item is covered (7.1.7(h)); reference case 12 includes removal in the main replacement line, but as a separate line, t is likely modest.

items.description: Transport and disposal of the damaged table (2 pcs)
items.rationale: Transport/disposal of destroyed furnishing item is covered (7.1.7(h)); reference case 12 includes this in the main replacement line, but as a separate line, t is likely modest.

items.description: Supply of replacement kitchen table, comparable specification to the original
items.rationale: Replacement of destroyed furnishing item is covered (7.1.1(d)), and new-for-old option is in force; invoice states EUR 440 before VAT, so t = 440 + 19% VAT = 523.60.

items.description: Delivery of the replacement table
items.rationale: Delivery of replacement furnishing item is covered (7.1.7(h)); reference case 12 includes delivery in the main replacement line, but as a separate line, t is likely modest.

items.description: Assembly and cleaning of the installation area
items.rationale: Assembly and cleaning for replacement furnishing item is covered (7.1.7(h)); reference case 12 includes this in the main replacement line, but as a separate line, t is likely modest.

items.description: Vehicle costs (carpentry)
items.rationale: First vehicle/call-out charge per contractor is covered (7.1.7(f)); reference case 14 shows t between 13 and 16 for vehicle costs.

items.description: Vehicle costs – return visit (carpentry)
items.rationale: Second vehicle/call-out charge per contractor is excluded (7.1.8(b)); reference cases 11, 17 show t = 0 for return visit vehicle costs.

items.description: Inspection of further furniture items stored in the garden for moisture
items.rationale: Inspection of unaffected property is excluded (7.1.8(f)); reference cases 11, 17 show t = 0 for similar lines.
